$schema_note: Metadata for columns produced by data/scraper.py -> llm_benchmarks.csv. test_areas use coarse categories for filtering and analysis.

test_area_vocab.math: Symbolic and numerical problem solving, competition-style and grade-school math.
test_area_vocab.coding: Program synthesis, debugging, repository tasks, and developer-style workflows.
test_area_vocab.knowledge: Broad factual and academic knowledge across domains (exam-style QA).
test_area_vocab.reasoning: Multi-step logic, puzzles, and difficult reasoning beyond single facts.
test_area_vocab.science: Graduate-level STEM understanding and scientific QA.
test_area_vocab.instruction_following: Adherence to explicit constraints, formats, and policy in prompts.
test_area_vocab.safety: Robustness to misuse, evasion, or policy-violating requests.
test_area_vocab.document_vision: Text extraction and understanding from images or scanned documents (OCR).
test_area_vocab.chat_human_eval: Crowdsourced preference or Elo from human side-by-side chat comparisons.
test_area_vocab.environment: Resource or emissions estimate, not a capability score.
test_area_vocab.coverage: How many official benchmark results are present for the model in OpenEvals.

Model.description: Hugging Face model identifier (organization/repository name) used as the stable key across sources.
Model.source: merged (Open LLM Leaderboard fullname, OpenEvals model_name)

Release Date.description: Approximate release or first upload date on the Hub when available; may be enriched from Hugging Face model metadata if --enrich-dates is used.
Release Date.source: Open LLM Leaderboard Upload To Hub Date and/or Hugging Face API

Origin.description: Inferred country or region of the releasing organization, based on a static namespace map; empty when the org is unmapped. Not verified from legal entity or hosting location.

oe_aggregate.description: OpenEvals composite score summarizing performance across the official benchmarks included in the OpenEvals leaderboard table.

oe_aime2026.description: Score on AIME-style competition mathematics problems (2026 suite in OpenEvals naming).

oe_coverage_count.description: Count of official benchmark results available for this model within the OpenEvals aggregation (coverage metadata, not a skill test).

oe_coverage_percent.description: Percentage of tracked OpenEvals benchmarks for which this model has a submitted score.

oe_evasionBench.description: EvasionBench evaluates resistance to circumventing safeguards or policy (jailbreak-style pressure).

oe_gpqa.description: GPQA: graduate-level multiple-choice questions in biology, physics, and chemistry (hard for non-experts).
oe_gpqa.note: Distinct from oll_GPQA: different pipeline/scale than Open LLM Leaderboard GPQA column.

oe_gsm8k.description: GSM8K: grade-school math word problems requiring short chain-of-thought style reasoning.

oe_hle.description: Humanity's Last Exam (HLE): very difficult cross-domain questions aimed at frontier models.

oe_hmmt2026.description: HMMT-style mathematics competition problems (2026 naming in OpenEvals).

oe_mmlu_pro.description: MMLU-Pro: harder, less noisy variant of broad multi-task knowledge evaluation.
oe_mmlu_pro.note: Related but not identical to oll_MMLU_PRO (different suite/version context).

oe_olmOcr.description: olmOCR-focused metric: OCR and text recovery from document images in the OpenEvals table.

oe_swePro.description: SWE-bench Pro variant: harder software-engineering repair tasks in repositories.

oe_sweVerified.description: SWE-bench Verified: subset of SWE-bench with independently verified issue resolutions.

oe_terminalBench.description: TerminalBench: tasks involving shell/terminal interaction and command-line problem solving.

oll_BBH.description: BIG-Bench Hard (BBH): challenging subset of BIG-Bench requiring multi-step reasoning.

oll_CO2_kg.description: Estimated CO2 emissions (kg) associated with evaluation runs as reported on the Open LLM Leaderboard; reflects compute footprint, not model accuracy.

oll_GPQA.description: GPQA scores as computed in the Open LLM Leaderboard harness (normalized/scaled for that leaderboard).
oll_GPQA.note: Not directly comparable to oe_gpqa without checking leaderboard methodology.

oll_IFEval.description: IFEval: instruction-following evaluation with verifiable constraints (format, counts, keywords).

oll_MATH_lvl5.description: MATH benchmark level-5 difficulty problems (competition-style math in the OLL suite).

oll_MMLU_PRO.description: MMLU-Pro scores in the Open LLM Leaderboard evaluation setup.

oll_MUSR.description: MUSR: multi-step reasoning tasks often involving longer contexts or structured problems.

oll_average.description: Open LLM Leaderboard aggregate average across the benchmarks included in that leaderboard snapshot.

arena_text_elo.description: Chatbot Arena text leaderboard Elo (human pairwise votes), merged via slug heuristic when --arena is used; many models will be empty if no match.
arena_text_elo.source: LMSYS-style Arena data via public mirror API (see scraper.py)
arena_text_elo.note: Reflects perceived helpfulness/style in open-ended chat, not a fixed dataset accuracy.
